description: This file provides utility functions for handling JSON files, path normalization within repositories, and executing and processing Vitest test reports. It includes functions to read/write JSON, normalize repository paths, run Vitest with JSON report output, and collect test durations from reports.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Replaces OS-specific path separators with forward slashes to normalize repository paths.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes a given path relative to the repository root, handling absolute and relative paths appropriately.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from disk and parses its contents.

methods.name: tryReadJsonFile
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse a JSON file; returns a fallback value if reading or parsing fails.

methods.name: writeJsonFile
methods.description: Serializes a value into JSON and writes it into a file.

methods.name: runVitestJsonReport
methods.description: Executes Vitest with JSON report output, returning the path to the report file. Optionally accepts a report path and prefix.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Processes a Vitest JSON report to extract file durations and test counts, normalizing filenames as needed.
